name: Christine Halden
title: Psychologist
description: I’m a psychologist who blends evidence-based approaches with real-world compassion to help clients sharpen their skills, deepen their self-awareness, and reconnect with purpose. I often work with people who are over-functioning or seem like they're functioning well but want to improve their emotional intelligence, leadership, relationships, and life direction. I create a warm, collaborative space that honours complexity—whether you’re navigating personal growth, trauma recovery, chronic pain, or attachment dynamics. My approach integrates CBT, schema therapy, ACT, and somatic awareness, tailored to your goals.

name: Claire Naidoo
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I offer a warm, relational space where you can feel deeply seen, understood, and safe to explore what’s happening beneath the surface. I believe meaningful change comes through insight, emotional connection, and a strong therapeutic relationship, alongside supporting your nervous system to feel more regulated and grounded. I work with adults navigating trauma, emotional intensity, life transitions, and questions of identity — often people who are high-functioning on the outside but struggling internally. I then moved into psychology and have since worked across public and private mental health settings with adults experiencing trauma, personality difficulties, anxiety, and highly complex presentations, including psychosis.
specialties: PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, EMDR, Trauma-Informed

name: Krista Senden
title: Social Worker, Counsellor
description: Guided by a strong commitment to social justice and human dignity, I have worked extensively with people seeking support with trauma, mental health concerns and difficult life circumstances. I have developed strong expertise in working with complex trauma, grief, depression, anxiety, emotional distress and the impact of prolonged stress. These experiences deepened my understanding of how trauma, loss and prolonged stress can shape people’s lives. I have worked for many years within specialist trauma and grief services in Australia. I have developed strong expertise in working with complex trauma, grief, depression, mental health conditions, emotional distress, and the impact of prolonged stress.

name: Vanessa Wylie
title: Counsellor, Relationship Therapist
description: I’m a relationship-focused therapist supporting individuals and couples to navigate complicated relationships and reconnect with themselves and others. Many of my clients feel stuck, overwhelmed or disconnected, often facing betrayal, separation, parenting stress or life transitions.
